issue_context.title: Select generated column with limit failed
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```sql
drop table if exists t;
create table t (a int, b int as (a + 1));
insert into t(a) values (1);
select b from t limit 1;
```

<!-- a step by step guide for reproducing the bug. -->

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

```console
+------+
| b    |
+------+
|    2 |
+------+
```

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)
```console
ERROR 1105 (HY000): Can't find column test.t.a in schema Column: [test.t.b] Unique key: []
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

<!-- Paste the output of SELECT tidb_version() -->
master
```
commit 4e58f329b1428d8d863266eab6c6fbb6fda34d8f (HEAD, upstream/master)
```

review_comments:
`PhysicalLimit` inherits its child schema in the old implementation. I think the problem is that `ExpandVirtualColumns` of `TableScan` happens **AFTER** inheritance.

Inheritance: 
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/369c12f779f8e990f38af6a158be1d702aef4922/planner/core/task.go#L718

ExpandVirtualColumn:
https://github.com/pingcap/tidb/blob/369c12f779f8e990f38af6a158be1d702aef4922/planner/core/task.go#L730

ExpandVirtualColumns of TableScan happens AFTER inheritance.

It is. So let them share the same schema.
